newsitem.title: USA: Service Experts names Ronald Smith COO.
newsitem.headline: Service Experts names Ronald Smith COO.

text.p: Service Experts Inc said Friday it named Ronald Smith as its chief operating officer.
The company said James Abrams, president and chief operating officer of the company, will return his focus to expanding the consulting programs of Service Experts' Contractor Success Group unit.
Alan Seilbach, chief executive officer and chairman, will assume Abrams' the postition of president.
Smith owns the consulting firm Ron Smith and Associates, which will merge into service experts and become a wholly owned subsidiary of Service Experts.
